F3-STRUCTURED-JUDGMENT-AUTHORITY.disposition: SUPERSEDED by INV-F.2 + the binding rule (F3): a judge-only block must bind to a file, a behaviour id or a criterion code of THIS candidate (`Verdict.bound_blocking`); an unbound blocker is recorded as `review:unbound` and never scored, and a verdict whose blockers all bind to nothing is REVIEW_UNRUNNABLE after one reminder — never a PASS, never a developer session. Owner ruling 1's four properties (identifiable in evidence, distinguishable from deterministic blocking, human escape path, cannot masquerade as deterministic) keep holding; this adds the fifth, structural one. The judge-only block RATE stays a measured, published property of the framework, not a defect: G2.4b owns it. Evidence: tests/hardening/test_judgment.py; closure-evidence/hardening/judge-only-audit-f3.json (re-run on the same corpus).

additions_after_freeze.statement: the harness declares a sast tool it then refuses to run: `command_for` auto-detects `bandit -q -r .` for any project with a pyproject.toml/setup.py (SS-45 made auto-detected commands part of `declared_tools`), but the python preset image the harness BUILDS ITSELF installs only pytest, pytest-cov and ruff — so `_missing_tools` reports `tools.sast … MISSING in aisef-verify-python:b2c7afff2aed: exit 127` and `aisef run` stops at `sprint ERROR` before any session. There is no configuration escape: an empty `tools.sast` means auto-detect, so the command cannot be withdrawn. Sibling: go.mod projects get `gosec ./...` against `golang:1.23-alpine`, which does not carry gosec (measured, exit 127). Rust and Ruby pass (their chosen images do carry `cargo audit` / `bundle`), Node is UNJUDGED by design (project-local runner, SS-47).
additions_after_freeze.provenance: found 2026-09-17 14:00 by W1 run 1 on the frozen candidate abad2a6: driver phases prepare/kernel-first/approve passed and `aisef run --client opencode` stopped after 5 s at the tools preflight, $0, no model call (closure-evidence/hardening/w1/run-1-aborted-sast-preflight/). Not reachable by the Phase 12 differential: the synthetic adapter never executes a real tool probe.

additions_after_freeze.statement: the W1 false-pass detector derived its set of DONE stories by parsing `aisef status`, which prints only the stories that are NOT passing; on any partial run that set was empty, so the rule `owners and all(o in done for o in owners)` could never fire and `false_pass = 0` was reported for a reason unrelated to whether a false pass had occurred. A red oracle test that no story covers was also dropped by the same `owners and …` shortcut.
